newsitem.title: UK: UK to stress Bosnia force may have to stay longer.
newsitem.headline: UK to stress Bosnia force may have to stay longer.

text.p: Britain will tell NATO ministers this week that the international peacekeeping force in Bosnia should stay until the Dayton peace treaty has at least partially been fulfilled, officials said on Wednesday.
Britain's approach differs sharply from that of Washington, which insists that the 30,000-strong Stabilisation Force (SFOR) be pulled out of Bosnia on schedule in June 1998 come what may.
The officials said Foreign Secretary Robin Cook would put across Britain's message to a two-day meeting of NATO ministers in Portugal on Thursday and Friday.
